name: Status Communities
description: Status App channel plugin — send and receive messages privately in Status communities via Logos messaging (Waku protocol).

backendUrl.description: URL of the running status-backend process

keyUID.description: Status account key UID for re-login (obtained after first CreateAccountAndLogin)

dataDir.description: Directory for status-backend data (keystore, DB, wallet)

displayName.description: Display name for the Status account (used on first account creation only)

backendBinary.description: Path to the status-backend executable. Auto-detected or built from source if not set.

communityIds.description: Status community ID(s) — hex (0x...) or invite link (https://status.app/c/...). Accepts a single string or an array. The plugin will auto-join these communities on gateway start.
